chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from his uncle Yaʿqūb al-Aḥmar, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about a man who had relations with his wife, then she menstruated before performing ghusl (ritual bath). He said: “She makes it one ghusl (ritual bath).”
ai.seo_question: If a woman menstruates before performing ghusl after marital relations, is one ghusl enough?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman who becomes menstruating after marital relations and before performing ghusl (ritual bath). The Imam عليه السلام states that one ghusl suffices, indicating the combining of the required ritual bath in this circumstance.
